exposure: Bundle of interventions (maintenance of head in neutral position with the body in supine position, minimal handling, delay of lumbar puncture until after 72 hours, absence of respiratory therapy maneuvers)
Cerebrospinal fluid collection within the first 72 hours of life
outcome: Incidence of intraventricular hemorrhage at hospital discharge
cohort: Preterm infants with gestational age < 32 weeks, without malformations, who survived >6 days and were admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: Implementation of a bundle of interventions was associated with a significant decrease in the chances of PIVH at hospital discharge in preterm infants.
